caption: The drawing depicts a single polished metal bowl positioned centrally on a blank, light-colored background. The bowl is rendered in shades of gray and reflects highlights and shadows that indicate its shiny, metallic surface. The bowl features a wide, open rim that tapers smoothly inward and downward to a narrower, slightly flared base with a rounded foot. Subtle shadowing beneath the base suggests the bowl is resting on a flat surface. Minimal line work is used around the bowl to define its contours, while tone and shading within the form illustrate its reflective nature and curved surface. There are no other objects or detailed background elements in the composition.
title: Silver Bowl
